blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Calvin Abueva has been summoned by PBA Commissioner Willie Marcial after being ejected in Converge’s 2026 Governors’ Cup quarterfinals clincher against Rain or Shine. Abueva is scheduled to appear before Marcial on Wednesday to explain not only his two technical fouls in the 120-109 win on Friday at Smart Araneta Coliseum, but also his actions upon leaving the playing court.
